'''August 1999 Menomonee Falls tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Arcade Comics, Menomonee Falls, WI on 12 August 1999. [[Ryan Fojtik]] won it. It is known from Ryan Fojtik's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d11">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-19-menomonee-falls-wi-8-12-99d11/ menomonee-falls-wi-8-12-99], DeckTech (Ryan "XjedeyeX" Fojtik, 19 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-19-menomonee-falls-wi-8-12-99d11/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 August 1999
* '''Site:''' Arcade Comics, Menomonee Falls, WI
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 17
* '''Winner:''' [[Ryan Fojtik]]
